scripts.text:
[Old Woman]
Greeting, lad. I found a really nifty item while I was picking mushrooms near Glast Heim.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
你好啊，小伙子。我在古城附近采蘑菇时，发现了一件很不错的东西。

scripts.text:
[Old Woman]
Hey, I remember you! I already told you that you may only complete this quest once.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
嘿，我记得你！我已经说过，这个任务只能完成一次。

scripts.text: Keep Talking
scripts.translation: 继续聊聊

scripts.text: Leave
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text:
[Old Woman]
I have never seen an item like this before. I am told it can be placed inside any accessory with a slot available.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
我以前从没见过这样的物品。听说它可以镶嵌在任何有插槽的饰品里。

scripts.text:
[Old Woman]
If you're interested in this item, I'll tell you what you need for me to make you one of your own. I can only give one of these to each player, so once you finish this quest, you may not do it again.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
如果你对它感兴趣，我可以告诉你制作一件需要哪些材料。每位玩家只能得到一件，所以完成这个任务后就不能再做了。

scripts.text: Tell me more about it
scripts.translation: 告诉我更多

scripts.text: Nah, I don't care about it
scripts.translation: 不，我不感兴趣

scripts.text:
[Old Woman]
I believe the item is called a ^FF0000Berzebub Card^000000. It makes you cast spells really fast!
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
我记得这件物品叫作^FF0000贝尔泽布卡片^000000。它能让你施法快得惊人！

scripts.text:
[Old Woman]
I need all of the following items:
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
我需要以下所有物品：

scripts.text: I have all of that!
scripts.translation: 我都有！

scripts.text: I'll get those ASAP
scripts.translation: 我会尽快去弄

scripts.text: [Old Woman]
scripts.translation: [老妇人]

scripts.text:
[Old Woman]
You lie! Get out of here and get those items, you sorry excuse for a rock star.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
你在撒谎！快滚出去把那些东西找来，你这个不成器的摇滚明星。

scripts.text:
[Old Woman]
Congratulations! You have all the items. Here is your ^FF0000Berzebub Card^000000, as promised.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
恭喜，你集齐了所有物品。这是答应给你的^FF0000贝尔泽布卡片^000000。

scripts.text: You lie! Get out of here and get those items, you sorry excuse for a rock star.
scripts.translation: 你在撒谎！快滚出去把那些东西找来，你这个不成器的摇滚明星。

scripts.text: Congratulations! You have all the items. Here is your ^FF0000Berzebub Card^000000, as promised.
scripts.translation: 恭喜，你集齐了所有物品。这是答应给你的^FF0000贝尔泽布卡片^000000。

scripts.text:
[Old Woman]
Such a great item I have right here...
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
我这里有件了不起的东西……
